'''Luis Basagaña Soto''' or '''Lluís''' (born 9 August 1963 in [[Andorra la Vella]], [[Andorra]]) is an [[Andorra]]n former footballer who last played for [[RCD Espanyol]] of the Spanish [[La Liga|Primera División]] for the 1984–85 season. He is the first Andorran to have played in [[La Liga]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.andorradifusio.ad/esports/basagana-koldo-marc-vales-ilde-lima|title=Basagaña, Koldo, Marc Vales i Ilde Lima, en el millor 11 andorrà|publisher=andorradifusio.ad}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.90min.com/es/posts/5316599-los-13-paises-que-han-tenido-algun-representante-en-la-liga-pero-nunca-han-marcado-un-gol|title=Los 13 países que han tenido algún representante en La Liga pero nunca han marcado un gol|date=27 July 2017 |publisher=90min.com}}</ref>

==RCD Espanyol==

Switching to [[RCD Espanyol]] of the Spanish top division for the [[1984-85 La Liga|1984-85]] season, Basagaña made his first-team debut on 9 September 1984, a 1–5 defeat to [[Valencia CF]];<ref name="fuerzaperica"/> that same day,<ref name="fuerzaperica"/> the [[Association of Spanish Footballers]] went on striker and remonstrated against the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation|Spanish Football Federation]] for various reasons.

He also featured in the [[1984–85 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]] through his time with the club.<ref name="fuerzaperica">[https://www.fuerzaperica.com/wiki/luis_basagaña_soto Fuerzaperica.com Profile]</ref>
